description: TU Delft and Amsterdam project partners publish five proof-load tests on four historic quay-wall segments at Overamstel in 2022. Ballast water loading increased soil stress behind the timber-founded walls. Instrumentation recorded structural and soil movements, applied load and water pressures. These observations support computational assessment of historic canal-wall lateral response. Coverage: 2022 Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: spreadsheets, documents. Licence: CC0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: The experiments concern specified segments of one wall. Results do not establish condition or capacity of every Amsterdam quay. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
